name: SuperHertz Marketplace
author: superhertzbiz

sections.description:
SuperHertz Marketplace is a comprehensive multi-vendor solution designed for high-scale WordPress environments. Built on a modular architecture, it transforms standard WordPress installations into professional-grade marketplace ecosystems with deep Elementor integration.

Key Features

  • Self-Service Partner Portal: Full frontend dashboard for vendors to manage products, policies, and orders without admin access.
  • Advanced Catalog Engine: Maintain consistency with Product Blueprints and a multi-step listing wizard.
  • Serviceability Logic: Geo-targeted product visibility based on customer pincodes.
  • Commercial Transaction Flow: Features a sliding AJAX cart, unified master checkout, and multi-vendor split-payment readiness.
  • Elementor Integration: Includes 15+ dedicated widgets for building custom marketplace views and dynamic listing templates.
  • Transaction Snapshotting: Core logic that “freezes” product data at the moment of order to ensure historical accuracy.
  • Modern Auth & UI: Animated authentication gates and a global toast notification system for an advanced user experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the superhertz-marketplace folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Marketplace > Settings to configure your branding and policies.
  4. Use Elementor to drag-and-drop the custom marketplace widgets into your pages.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, the plugin uses Elementor Pro and Base version to provide a visual way to build your marketplace pages.

Can partners manage their own shipping?

Absolutely. Each partner can define their own individual shipping, return, and cancellation policies through the Partner Dashboard.

If using Pro version, does the plugin need to be setup again?

Yes, the Pro version plugin is fully built seperately so it needs to be re-setup to take full advantage of the pro features and additions.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized and ready to be localized into any language.
